title: Understanding the Position Function
text: This represents a helical path where the particle moves in a circle in the xy-plane while moving linearly along the $$z-axis$$.

title: Finding the Velocity Vector
text: To find the velocity vector, differentiate the position function with respect to time $$t$$.

title: Calculate the Velocity Vector
text: Differentiate $$r(t)=\cos(1.0t)i+\sin(1.0t)j+tk$$ with respect to $$t$$ to find the velocity vector v(t).

title: Finding the Acceleration Vector
text: To find the acceleration vector, differentiate the velocity vector with respect to time $$t$$.

title: Calculate the Acceleration Vector
text: Differentiate $$v(t)=-\sin(1.0t)i+\cos(1.0t)j+k$$ with respect to $$t$$ to find the acceleration vector a(t).
